question: Which of the following states launched a flood-hazard zonation atlas as part of new disaster tools in mid-June 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Assam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The state of **Assam** launched a revised and comprehensive **Flood Hazard Zonation Atlas** in mid-**June 2025** to strengthen its disaster management capabilities.
 
• This atlas was primarily developed by the **Assam State Disaster Management Authority (ASDMA)** in collaboration with the **National Remote Sensing Centre (NRSC)** under the **Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)**.
 
• The primary objective of this tool is to provide a detailed **spatial analysis** of areas that are chronically affected by floods, utilizing **satellite imagery** and historical data spanning several decades.
 
• It serves as a **decision-support system** for government departments to plan infrastructure, such as embankments, roads, and bridges, in a manner that accounts for periodic **inundation** risks.
